version: 1
filesystem_policy:
  include_workdir: true
  read_only:
    - "/"
  read_write:
    - "/tmp"
landlock:
  compatibility: "hard_requirement"
network_policies:
  reef_run_listener:
    name: "reef_run_listener"
    endpoints:
      - host: "192.0.2.10"
        port: 4100
        protocol: "rest"
        enforcement: "enforce"
        rules:
          - allow:
              method: "POST"
              path: "/llm/anthropic/v1/messages"
        request_body_credential_rewrite: false
        allow_uninspected_credentials: false
        credential_binding:
          provider: "reef-run-155a155a155a155a155a155a155a155a"
      - host: "192.0.2.10"
        port: 4102
        protocol: "mcp"
        enforcement: "enforce"
        request_body_credential_rewrite: false
        allow_uninspected_credentials: false
        mcp:
          versions:
            - "2025-03-26"
          strict_tool_names: true
        rules:
          - allow:
              method: "initialize"
          - allow:
              method: "notifications/initialized"
          - allow:
              method: "tools/list"
          - allow:
              method: "tools/call"
              tool:
                any:
                  - "proofs.list"
                  - "budget.get"
                  - "plan.get_state"
                  - "plan.update_task"
                  - "openbrain.report_usage"
                  - "openbrain.inspect_memory"
                  - "openbrain.list_review_queue"
                  - "openbrain.review_memory"
                  - "openbrain.get_recall_trace"
                  - "openbrain.recall"
                  - "openbrain.writeback"
                  - "jira.get_issue"
        credential_binding:
          provider: "reef-run-155a155a155a155a155a155a155a155a"
    binaries:
      - path: "/usr/local/lib/node_modules/opencode-ai/bin/opencode.exe"
